scope: Early-time Figure2 prototype with graph-reconstructed cooling; not an independent historical rate reconstruction

cooling_digitization.method: Manually selected curve crossings; nearest contiguous dark-pixel run in a27-pixel vertical window; median ordinate. Points visually checked. Reading envelopes are not statistical confidence intervals.
cooling_digitization.interpolation: PCHIP of logLambda versus logT; piecewise linear Lambda in x, motivated by electron/neutral collider contributions at fixed trace-ion abundances. No extrapolation. A logLambda/logx alternative is reported as a sensitivity probe, not fitted to Figure2.

recombination: Hjellming1966 Eqs56-57 excited-state hydrogen approximation; exact fit used by Schwarz et al. not specified and not established here.
limitations: Cooling is reconstructed from the published Figure1, not independently recovered from every Jura–Dalgarno rate. Do not substitute the FGH or KI curve: the paper uses a different Fe abundance5e-5 perH.
Stop at the lower temperature or ionization boundary of the source readings. No late-time cold extrapolation or nonlinear cloud solution is claimed.
Initial perturbation is taken isobaric with uniform ionization and zero velocity; this is explicit for the nonlinear example, but its precise use for Figure2 requires further confirmation.
Linear amplitudes are normalized to n1(0)=1; a large amplification factor does not validate finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution.
He/H=.1 is neutral helium perH, unlike FGH He/(H+He)=.1. No external heating, continuing ionization, or gravity is included.
The note added in proof (p686) reports corrections to the Jura–Dalgarno cooling interpretation. Published figures and later corrected physics must remain distinct.

Eq7 defines radiated power per gram as nLambda/(1.4mH), while the Figure1 caption omits1.4. This implementation follows Eqs7–9 and does not rescale time to match Figure2. The caption inconsistency remains recorded.

growth_digitization.y_axis: log10(amplification); temperature is10 times the amplification-axis value at the same ordinate
growth_digitization.method: Sparse manual centerline readings on isolated parts of the curves. Crowded crossings avoided;3px practical envelopes, not statistical errors. An independent second reading has not been performed.
growth_digitization.calibration_note: Use the0–2Myr ticks bracketing all selected early-time readings. The full0–6Myr scan has slight horizontal distortion and is not assumed to have a single exact affine scale.
